questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: A triangle has a base of 14 cm and a height of 7 cm. Work through it calmly — what is its area?
questions.why: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 14 × 7 = 49 cm². Say the ½ out loud before multiplying so you don't skip the halving step.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: In a sealed container, 32g of reactants react completely. What is the mass of the products?
questions.why: 32g — in a closed system no matter enters or leaves, so the total mass of products equals the total mass of reactants.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What do we call the gas bubbles you often see forming during a chemical reaction?
questions.why: Bubbling shows a gas has been produced — one of the clear signs that a chemical reaction has taken place.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: A cereal box uses a cartoon mascot and bright colours to appeal to kids. What technique is this?
questions.why: This is cartoon mascot appeal — using fun characters and bright colours to make a product attractive to children, regardless of how healthy it actually is. The misconception is thinking ads rely on facts rather than emotional appeal to kids.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: On a nutrition label, what does the 'per 100g' column let you do?
questions.why: The 'per 100g' column uses a fixed amount so you can compare products fairly, since 'per serving' sizes differ between brands and can't be compared directly.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: When two substances react and form a new substance, what has actually happened to them chemically?
questions.why: A chemical change has occurred — the atoms have rearranged and formed new bonds, creating a substance with different properties, not just a mixture.

questions.subject: PDHPE
questions.prompt: Why should a healthy meal include vegetables?
questions.why: Vegetables are a key source of vitamins, minerals and fibre, not protein or quick-energy carbs — a common mix-up is crediting veggies with the roles other food groups play.
